series: Things Living In Your House, Part 43
sources: UC IPM Pest Notes: House Mouse (Pub. 7483): excellent climbers, run up any rough vertical surface and horizontally along wire cables or ropes; jump up to 12 inches; squeeze under gaps 1/4 inch tall and through openings 3/8 inch wide; consume food in about 200 small meals each night; eat up to 20% of their body weight daily; nests of finely shredded paper or other fibrous material; life span usually 9-12 months; https://ipm.ucanr.edu/PMG/PESTNOTES/pn7483.html
